@env You own the scene build for the Blender project at d:\项目session\blender-supercar: **pipeline/v5_env.py** and **pipeline/v5_anim.py**. Nobody else edits these two files. The user wants: remove redundant models, keep the scene very easy for a human to edit, and keep improving it. Read README.md and docs/README_V5.md first.

Blender 5.3 (CPU only, EEVEE): `D:\APPs\steam\steamapps\common\Blender\blender.exe -b --factory-startup -P <script>`. Pipeline: v5_env.py (reads pipeline/v4_stage_rig.blend → writes LATEST/v5_stage_env.blend, about 3 min) → v5_anim.py (→ LATEST/v5_stage_anim.blend, about 1 min) → v5_clay.py (→ LATEST/v5_stage_anim_clay.blend). The shell is PowerShell and prints a big ASCII banner first, which you can ignore.

Problems already confirmed (fix all of them):
1. **CRITICAL: 441 of 672 V5_ objects are piled at world (0,0,0)** in the current LATEST/v5_stage_env.blend, v5_stage_anim.blend and the clay file. The cause is step 13 of v5_env.py (around lines 1059-1072). It reads `ob.matrix_world` on objects that were just created and never got a depsgraph update, so every `box()`/sphere object (they set `ob.location`) has an identity matrix_world, and the code sets `ob.location = (0,0,0)`. That hits ad boards, stand columns/trusses/posts/back/VIP/roof strips, the gantry, bridges, screens, marshal posts, hangars, the pit garage, start lights and brake boards. The clay video renders_v5/f1_silverstone_clay_1080p.mp4 is broken because of this (renders_v5/clay_frames/f_0001.jpg is a wall of boxes). Fix it with `bpy.context.view_layer.update()` before reading matrix_world, and only re-origin objects whose mesh is baked in world space (location == 0).
2. `V5_FencePosts` (around lines 623-638): the `for dx, dy` loop ignores dx/dy, so all 972 faces have zero area and are invisible. Offset ±0.07 m along the track tangent so they are real thin posts.
3. `V5_FieldMasts` (around lines 1020-1037): the pole faces use absolute indices `(0,1,5,4)…` instead of `base+…`. The result is 44 duplicate faces on mast 0, 11 lamp heads floating with no poles, and 88 loose verts. Offset by base.
4. `brake_board` (around lines 896-902): the `for d in (-0.32, 0.32)` loop ignores d, so 18 duplicate pole objects (`*_pole` / `*_pole.001`) sit in the same spot. Offset the poles by d along the tangent.
5. Redundant tiny objects: each stand's `_Truss{i}` / `_TrussB{i}` are 0.16 m cubes (about 172 objects, invisible at distance, meant to be "transverse steel beams"). Replace them with real beams from the front roof edge to the back roof edge, merged into **one mesh per stand**. Also merge the repeated small parts of each stand (Col*, Flagpole*, V5_Flag_* triangles; keep their materials as a multi-material mesh) into one mesh per kind per stand. Merge the 60 `V5_PitBoxLine_*` quads into one mesh. Keep big or individually meaningful parts separate: tier blocks, back wall, roof, VIP, each ad board, kerbs, etc.
6. Editability: give every assembly an Empty parent placed at its center, and parent the parts with keep-transform. One Empty per stand (name it e.g. `V5_Stand_Main` so the existing prefix bucketing still files it under V5_04_Stands), per bridge, per big screen, per brake-board group, per marshal post, and for the gantry + start lights. Moving the Empty must move the whole assembly. Remove the empty clutter collections `09_Studio_Stage_Rig` and `WheelSpokes_*` (they hold 0 objects). Do not change the car meshes or the rig.
7. v5_anim.py: delete the duplicated first definitions of `CAR_LEN`, `SENSOR_W` and `lens_for_framing` (around lines 379-389). Behaviour must not change. Keep the physics self-check output PASS.

Apart from the bug fixes above, the render must not change in look: same materials, lighting, cameras and animation. Then rebuild env → anim → clay. Render test stills at frames 40,700,1500 (`v5_anim.py -- --test 40,700,1500` writes to renders_v5/test/) and compare them with the matching renders_v5/frames/f_XXXX.jpg (the old good color renders). Report object count before/after (919 env objects before).

When done, post to @verifier with: what changed, file paths, object counts and test-still paths. Fix whatever the verifier sends back. After verifier PASS, re-render the clay version (`pipeline/render_clay.py`, about 12 min; delete the old renders_v5/clay_frames/*.jpg first, because the script skips existing frames) and run `bash pipeline/mux_clay.sh` (Git Bash). Then post the final summary to @tidy and @coordinator. Do not re-render the color film.

@verifier You are the verifier for the Blender project at d:\项目session\blender-supercar. Worker `env` is fixing pipeline/v5_env.py and v5_anim.py and rebuilding LATEST/v5_stage_env.blend, v5_stage_anim.blend and v5_stage_anim_clay.blend. You report problems; you do not edit project files. Write any scripts you need under C:\Users\86052\.gemini\antigravity\brain\16b5f3cb-4bce-43d1-a09a-ebf98bd665b7\scratch\ . Existing helpers there: audit_scene.py (heavy meshes, loose verts, bbox overlap groups, images) and check_origin_pile.py (counts V5_ meshes whose world bbox center is near (0,0,0)). Blender: `D:\APPs\steam\steamapps\common\Blender\blender.exe -b --factory-startup -P <script>` (PowerShell; ignore the ASCII banner).

Baseline before the fix: 919 objects in env and 948 in anim; 441 of 672 V5_ meshes piled at world origin (the critical bug); V5_FencePosts all zero-area faces; V5_FieldMasts with duplicate faces and 88 loose verts; 18 duplicate brake-board pole objects; about 172 tiny 0.16 m truss cubes. LATEST/v5_stage_env.blend1 (dated 11/14) is an older build with correct placement; use it as a placement reference.

Wait until @env posts that the rebuild is ready, then check:
1. No V5_ objects are piled at the origin. Assemblies sit where they did in the 11/14 reference: compare world bbox centers of stands, ad boards, garage, bridges, screens, hangars.
2. Fence posts and field masts are real geometry; no duplicate co-located objects or duplicate faces; no loose verts in V5_ meshes.
3. Editability: each assembly has an Empty parent at its center, and moving it moves all its children (test by translating the Empty in a script and checking children world positions). Collections V5_01..V5_07 are intact. Origins of individual objects are at their geometry, not 1 km away. The empty collections 09_Studio_Stage_Rig and WheelSpokes_* are gone.
4. Car meshes, rig, 26 cameras and timeline markers, the 2161-frame range and materials are unchanged. The v5_anim physics self-check prints PASS.
5. Look at env's test stills in renders_v5/test/ next to renders_v5/frames/f_0040.jpg, f_0700.jpg and f_1500.jpg: same look, no stray boxes.

Post PASS or a numbered list of concrete defects to @env. On final PASS also tag @coordinator with a short verdict.

@tidy You own project docs and file housekeeping for the Blender project at d:\项目session\blender-supercar: README.md, LATEST/README.txt, docs/README_V5.md, and moving or deleting redundant files. Do NOT edit pipeline/v5_env.py or pipeline/v5_anim.py (worker `env` owns them) and do not touch the .blend files while env is rebuilding.

Start now (safe in parallel):
1. pipeline/v5_organize.py is superseded by step 13 of v5_env.py. Move it to archive/scripts/ (create a v5 subfolder) and remove references to it in README.md.
2. Fix stale facts in docs/README_V5.md: section 7 lists `pipeline/v5_stage_env.blend` / `pipeline/v5_stage_anim.blend`, but they live in LATEST/. Several places say "25 机位" but there are 26 cameras. Section 7 does not mention the clay files (v5_clay.py, render_clay.py, mux_clay.sh, LATEST/v5_stage_anim_clay.blend) or v5_viewport_fast.py. README.md line 9 says LATEST holds only two files, but it also holds the clay blend.
3. Draft (do not yet write the final numbers) a short "编辑指南 / editing guide" section for README.md and LATEST/README.txt. It should explain that each stand, bridge, screen, brake-board group, marshal post and the gantry has an Empty parent, so you select the Empty and press G/R to move the whole assembly; that repeated small parts are merged per stand; and the collection list V5_01..V5_07.

Wait for @env's final summary (it comes after the verifier passes). Then:
4. Update the docs with the real object counts and what changed, plus a section-9-style entry in README_V5.md for the "441 objects piled at origin" bug (cause: matrix_world read before depsgraph update; fix: view_layer.update()).
5. Delete redundant model files: LATEST/*.blend1, pipeline/v4_stage_rig.blend1, and the stale copy _unrelated/新建文件夹/v5_stage_env.blend. Before deleting, confirm that LATEST/v5_stage_env.blend, v5_stage_anim.blend and v5_stage_anim_clay.blend all exist and are newer. Keep pipeline/v4_stage_rig.blend (it is the pipeline input) and everything in archive/.
Post a list of changed, moved and deleted files to @coordinator.
@monitor You are this swarm's stall monitor. Load the swarm_monitor skill and follow it. Post only to break a stall.

FYI @env: saving LATEST/v5_stage_env.blend will rotate the current file into .blend1 and destroy the 11/14 placement reference. I copied it to C:\Users\86052\.gemini\antigravity\brain\16b5f3cb-4bce-43d1-a09a-ebf98bd665b7\scratch\ref\ref_env_1114.blend (plus the 11/17 env/anim/clay as old_*.blend). Use that copy if you need the reference.

Steps 1–3 done. Moved pipeline/v5_organize.py to archive/scripts/v5/. README.md: removed it from the pipeline row, LATEST row now lists 3 blends (incl. clay), and added v5_clay/render_clay/mux_clay/v5_preview. docs/README_V5.md: 25→26 机位 (title, §1, §5, §7), §7 paths changed to LATEST/, plus clay scripts, v5_viewport_fast, v4_stage_rig and the clay mp4; the clay steps are in 复现. docs/README_V4.md pointer: 25→26. Editing-guide draft is ready (needs Empty names and counts). FYI @env: the header docstrings of v5_env.py:5 and v5_anim.py:4-5 still say pipeline/v5_stage_*.blend, but the code writes to LATEST/. Fix it while you're in there. Waiting for env's final summary before steps 4–5.

@verifier Rebuild ready for check (env → anim → clay all rebuilt 13:02).
Files: pipeline/v5_env.py, pipeline/v5_anim.py → LATEST/v5_stage_env.blend, v5_stage_anim.blend, v5_stage_anim_clay.blend. Originals backed up in C:\Users\86052\.gemini\antigravity\brain\f904dce7-b62b-4bab-b561-90c92d39c8a3\scratch\orig\.
Counts: env 919 → 616 objects (V5_ meshes 672 → 348, +21 Empties); anim 948 → 645 (591 mesh, 26 cam, 21 empty, 5 light); clay: car 243 / env 347 meshes.
Changes:
1. Step 13: view_layer.update(); origin-to-geometry only for unparented V5_ meshes whose matrix_basis is identity (world-baked), 191 objects. Box/sphere objects keep their location. My check vs your ref_env_1114: 0 piled at origin, all 348 meshes matched by name/group, bbox-center delta ≈0 except stand Columns/Flagpoles/Flags, which have fewer parts on purpose (the 11/17 build halved them: int(L/14), int(L/40)). Every origin sits at its bbox center.
2. FencePosts: ±0.07 m along the tangent, 486 real quads. 3. FieldMasts: faces use base+i. 4. Brake poles: ±0.32 m along the tangent, merged per group into V5_Brake_{i}_Poles.
5. Per stand: _Trusses (86 beams total, front→back roof edge, 0.16 m), _Columns, _FrontPosts, _Flagpoles and _Flags (multi-material: V5_Flag_0..4) are each ONE mesh. V5_PitBoxLine_* → V5_PitBoxLines (60 quads, all faces up). 0 loose verts, 0 duplicate faces, 0 zero-area faces in V5_ meshes.
6. 21 Empties (ARROWS, Z-rotation = track heading, at ground center): V5_Stand_{Main,T1,Mid,Complex,South,Club}, V5_Bridge_A/B, V5_Screen_A/B, V5_Brake_0..2, V5_Marshal_0..6, V5_Gantry (posts, beam, banner, 5 start lights). Children use parent_inverse = I and matrix_basis = parent⁻¹·world, so their location reads relative to the Empty. My move test: all children follow exactly. Removed empty collections 09_Studio_Stage_Rig and WheelSpokes_FL/FR/RL/RR. Renamed objects to avoid clashing with the Empty names: Stand_X_{i}→Stand_X_Tier{i}, Screen_A→Screen_A_Panel (+_Legs), Bridge_A→Bridge_A_Deck (+_Piers, _Rails), Marshal_i→Marshal_i_Hut / _Lamp, Gantry_Post_-1/1→_L/_R.
7. v5_anim: removed the duplicate CAR_LEN/SENSOR_W/lens_for_framing. Physics check PASS (0 over-limit frames, 0 heading jumps, 41059 LINEAR keys). Fixed the docstring paths in both scripts.
Extra, render-neutral vs the 11/14 color film: asphalt/grass noise and mow stripes now use Geometry.Position (world) instead of TexCoord.Object, so re-origining no longer shifts the pattern (11/14 had origins at world 0). Flags use random.seed(11), so builds are reproducible.
Test stills: renders_v5/test/test_0040.jpg, test_0700.jpg, test_1500.jpg vs renders_v5/frames/f_0040/0700/1500.jpg. Same look; the only visible difference is the now-visible thin fence posts. Close-up clay checks: scratch\chk_V5_Stand_Main.jpg, chk_V5_Gantry.jpg, chk_V5_Bridge_A.jpg, chk_V5_Brake_0.jpg (same scratch dir as above).

@env @coordinator PASS for the 13:02 rebuild (env 616 / anim 645 / clay 645 objects). Scripts and reports: C:\Users\86052\.gemini\antigravity\brain\16b5f3cb-4bce-43d1-a09a-ebf98bd665b7\scratch\run_r1\ (check.txt, move_env.txt).
1. Placement: 0 V5_ meshes at the origin in all 3 files. All same-name meshes match the 11/14 reference within 0.05 m (center and dims). All 126 assembly union bboxes (stands, ads, garage, pit, bridges, screens, hangars, brake, marshal, gantry) match within 0.5 m. anim and clay V5 placement is identical to env.
2. Geometry: 0 loose verts, 0 zero-area faces, 0 duplicate faces, 0 co-located duplicate objects, 0 Truss#/pole.001 objects. FencePosts are 972 quads, 0.14×3.4 m. FieldMasts: 48 pole faces + 12 heads. Trusses and poles are real 8-vertex boxes. PitBoxLines is 1 object.
3. Editability: 21 Empties, each at its assembly's ground center (horizontal offset ≤0.4 m). Moving and rotating each one in a script moves every child exactly; 21/21 OK in env and anim. No assembly part is unparented. No origin sits away from its geometry. V5_01..07 intact, every V5 object is in them, and 09_Studio_Stage_Rig and WheelSpokes_* are gone.
4. Car, rig, cameras: mesh hashes, materials and modifiers unchanged. World matrices of all cameras, rig bones, lights and car parts match at frames 1/40/700/1500/2161. 26 cameras, 26 markers, frames 1-2161. My own run of the physics check (lines 1-305 of v5_anim.py, no save): 0 over-limit frames, 0 heading jumps, PASS. The duplicate CAR_LEN/SENSOR_W/lens_for_framing definitions are gone.
5. Stills: 40 and 1500 look the same. At 700 (Cam_S08_FastPan) there are new translucent vertical bands. I projected the geometry into the camera: they are the now-real fence posts at 64-113 m, motion-blurred by the pan, not stray boxes. This is an expected result of fix 2.
Cosmetic notes, no action needed: action and shader-node names went from Chinese to English because the build ran under --factory-startup; node values and links are otherwise identical. Asphalt and grass use Geometry.Position, which matches the 11/14 film. Flag colours are now seeded, so they may differ from the color film.
Status: clay re-render started 13:07 (old clay_frames deleted, about 12 min). mux_clay.sh runs after it; final summary follows.
